title: Israel assassinating Nazi rocket scientists in Egypt via the Gehlen organization

tellings.quote: Israel was assassinating Nazi scotet scientists in Egypt that were developing you know rocket weapons for the Egyptian military but leveraging you know the Gellen organization I believe

plain: Israel killed former Nazi scientists who were building rocket weapons for the Egyptian military, and did so with help from the Gehlen organization, a West German spy network led by Reinhard Gehlen. A Pentagon whistleblower named Matthew Brown says this, adding that he believes the Gehlen link but without naming a source. He tells it as an example of tangled, hidden alliances among spy services after the war.
